images.caption:
A headstone in the cemetery of the Cathedral of St. John in Providence RI marking the graves of three enslaved Black women: Phillis, Rose & Fanny Chace.
The text on the headstone reads: 

In memory of three respectable black persons, Phillis, Rose & Fanny Chace, who served faithfully in the family of Samuel Chace Esq. The Wise, the gay, the Humble, and the exalted, the beautiful and the deformed; must all moulder, in the same native clay.
images.alt:
